summary: Master the basics of digital forensics in our engaging training course. Equip yourself with the knowledge to tackle cybercrime and data breaches.
lede: Digital forensics training helps professionals supporting authorized investigations preserve and examine digital evidence through a repeatable workflow. Learners practice creating forensic images, checking SHA-256 hashes, reviewing file-system and network artifacts, and building event timelines. They also document findings and explain their limits in concise reports, while memory analysis, cloud forensics, malware reverse engineering, and encrypted-device recovery remain overview topics.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who support authorized digital investigations, incident response, evidence preservation, and security review. It suits foundation-to-intermediate learners who need practical forensic workflow skills without a programming requirement.
prerequisites: No programming experience is required. You should have basic familiarity with operating systems, files, networks, cybersecurity incidents, and organizational security policies. You must work only with authorized training datasets and investigation scenarios. A laptop is recommended for laboratory activities, subject to the delivery setup.
